en.bdb: Being without Guru but getting called the Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਨੀਂਗਰ ਖੇਲਦੇ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਇਕਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: raatee nee(n)gar kheladhe sabh hoi ikaThe|

en.bdb: Children play getting together in the evening.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਪਰਜਾ ਹੋਵਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਗ ਉਪਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: raajaa parajaa hovadhe kar saa(n)g upaThe|

en.bdb: Someone disguised as King and the rest as subjects, they enact ridiculous scenes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਲਸਕਰ ਲੈ ਧਾਵਦੇ ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਨਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: eik lasakar lai dhaavadhe ik firadhe naThe|

en.bdb: Some of them leading the army rush from place to place and some getting defeated flee helter-skelter.

verses.gurmukhi: ਠੀਕਰੀਆਂ ਹਾਲੇ ਭਰਨਿ ਉਇ ਖਰੇ ਅਸਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: Theekareeaa(n) haale bharan ui khare asaThe|

en.bdb: They pay tax by offering potshreds and thus become wise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੇਡ ਉਜਾੜਿਦੇ ਘਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਨੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਠੇ।
verses.translit_en: khin vich khedd ujaaRidhe ghar ghar noo(n) traThe|

en.bdb: Within few moments they ruin their game and run for their homes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ਓਇ ਖੋਟੇ ਮਠੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit_en: vin gun guroo sadhaidhe oi khoTe maThe ||9||

en.bdb: Those who without merit call themselves Guru, are sluggish dissemblers.
